text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh... My legs are so heavy! My heartbeat 
is deafening...! 
I lack the sheer desperation needed to 
push past my limits!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, on the final stretch... 
I will not be able to run as I desire—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...So what of it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Will I make excuses that my spirit was 
not at its best? 
Will I plead that as reason for why I 
could not win?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Such a frail weakling is not who I am!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...
(Waaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...For now, the result is decided. 
It seems I managed to avoid an unsightly 
display...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Phalaenopsis!" "Great job!" 
"That was an amazing run!"

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Voices of applause. They are certainly 
there, yet...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Why does it feel so distant...?

I went to greet Phalaenopsis as she 
returned. 
Breathing a sigh of relief, I called out 
to her.
choice_data_list:
Great job out there! That was a fantastic 
run!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I gave it my utmost. 
With this, we are one step closer to that 
beautiful garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (...Or so it should be.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Regarding our next 
objective... 
Though we took a detour, if we are to 
continue down 
the Tiara path, there is only one choice, 
yes?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's enter the Victoria Mile.
Yeah, let's enter the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile is a race where 
Senior Tiara horsegirls gather to 
decide the strongest over the mile.

If she claims victory here, her standing 
along 
the Tiara route will only soar higher—

To leave hoofprints for successors to look 
up to, 
walking the royal road of the Tiara makes 
this an essential step.
choice_data_list:
Let's show them the true caliber of a 
Tiara horsegirl!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us go and show them 
just what a magnificent bloom Phalaenopsis 
is.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's all cheer them on 
together! 
Spe-chan and the others in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Let us bear witness with our own 
eyes 
to the great strides our generation makes.
choice_data_list:
Oh, the screen switched to the paddock 
footage.

Ah, the broadcast switched over to the 
paddock.

text_block_list.text:
In this year's Tenno Sho (Spring), 
Special Week, Seiun Sky... 
and Mejiro Bright have all stepped up to 
compete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A wonderful day to you all~.

She was last year's Tenno Sho (Spring) 
champion, 
a seasoned stayer flourishing at long 
distances— 
and an easygoing young lady bearing the 
Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to today, to this very stage... 
slowly, 
but surely, I have polished myself~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: All for the sake of Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober has become a queen worthy of our 
name. 
And just like her, I too... 
wish to bring home glory once more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so—another victory. 
I shall be claiming it for myself today~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san is quite the contender herself, 
after all~... 
I wonder if Spe-chan and the others will 
be okay.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true... 
Still... Spe today might just overcome 
even that—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san! 
Let's have a great race today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes, let us do our best together~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing what you said just now, 
I could feel your absolute resolve, 
Bright-san. 
Your resolve to carry the Mejiro name on 
your shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I won't lose, either!! 
Not when it comes to resolve!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"This girl is gonna become the number one 
horsegirl in Japan"— 
I'm gonna run in a way that makes everyone 
believe that!!!

And so the Tenno Sho (Spring) gets 
underway! 
Special Week, who had been marking Seiun 
Sky closely, 
enters the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh—!" 
"Ngh...!"

Overtaking Seiun Sky, she seizes the lead. 
And just as the chase behind her ignites—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright! Mejiro Bright! 
She's still a length behind, one length 
behind!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Special Week! In the end it came down 
to 
these three, but it's Special Week!! 
A decisive triumph for Special Week!!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Spe-chan's closing kick at 
the end... 
was just insane...!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah...! That gave me goosebumps.
Y-Yeah...! That was totally electrifying.

text_block_list.text:
It was an immaculate victory. On the final 
stretch, 
Special Week surged forward at the perfect 
moment— 
and with an explosive burst of speed, won 
without contest.

Demonstrating her blistering late kick and 
fierce mental grit 
to the absolute fullest, she earned this 
result. No tricks, no gimmicks. 
With pure, straightforward strength, she 
utterly overwhelmed the field.
choice_data_list:
That race proved her undeniable "ability" 
beyond all doubt...

That race was a true testament to her 
undeniable "ability"...

text_block_list.text:
A performance truly worthy of one hailed 
among the era's strongest. 
Today's star was, without question—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for cheering for me! 
Hearing 
everyone's voices pushed me forward, and 
that's how I got to stand here today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win against Bright-san and 
Sei-chan 
so, so badly! 
I'm just overflowing with happiness!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'd love it if you all came to the track 
to root for me again! 
Because next time, I'll show you an even 
stronger—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
An even stronger me, the best in all of 
Japan! 
It's a promise!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: ...Phalaeno? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...No, it is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...I can feel the ground beneath my feet 
beginning to waver.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I believed I would catch up eventually. 
That as long as I continued to train, I 
could reach the same radiance. 
And yet... is that how it is...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...So they, too, were merely "on their 
way."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The girls from the Japan Cup are no 
longer there. 
With the Tenno Sho (Spring), their backs 
have pulled further away once more.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(To ignite such fervor—that is the 
"splendor" of a competitor. 
Those girls have acquired an elegance far 
greater than in days past.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......How much further do I fall short?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(To make our Club into the "most exquisite 
garden"... 
how much more discipline must I cultivate 
to achieve that?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Will I reach it? Truly...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...How pathetic of me. What am I 
uttering...? 
Such faint-heartedness...—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do not rush. Do not waver. We... 
have not yet lost sight of our 
long-cherished ambition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To blossom into a peerless flower, just 
like Brian. 
That will suffice. Therein lies the future 
of our Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Yet, even if I were to become that 
peerless flower, 
unfurling my most radiant petals...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —What if no one looks upon me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If everyone is captivated by Spe and the 
others... 
and pays me no heed at all... then that 
would be...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Where is our garden to be found—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, *haa*, *haa*... 
Are we about halfway done now?
choice_data_list:
Huh? No, not yet. We still have eight sets 
left.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
What could I have been thinking...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Forgive me. Let us continue.
choice_data_list:
(...Lately, something's been off with 
Phalaeno.)

text_block_list.text:
Up until now, she had always tackled her 
training with diligence. 
Lately, however, there were more and more 
days 
where her focus seemed to wander.

When I checked, her physical condition was 
fine. She even 
underwent a thorough medical checkup, but 
it didn't seem that 
any physical ailment was to blame.

If so, perhaps she was shouldering 
something on her mind. 
As her Trainer, I asked her 
so we could share the burden.
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......There is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—No. Forgive me, I spoke nonsense. 
To utter falsehoods to the one whom I 
entrust my back...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What am I doing...?
choice_data_list: It's okay. Take your time.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...The truth is—

And so she confided in me— 
about her classmates' triumphs in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), 
and her own turbulent emotions shaking her 
heart because of it...
choice_data_list: Thank you for telling me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, the gratitude is mine... to think it 
was mere complaining, yet 
you lent me a sincere ear... I thank you.
choice_data_list: I'm your Trainer. It's only natural.
I'm your Trainer, so of course I would.

text_block_list.text:
Listening to her, I realized— 
she was still acutely conscious of those 
on the Classic route. 
Even though their ultimate destinations 
were supposed to differ.

—To achieve her grand ambition, she seemed 
to believe 
she needed to match the brilliance of her 
peers.
choice_data_list: (And that's precisely why she's wavering.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... 
What do you think?
choice_data_list: ......I think

text_block_list.text:
...I found myself shaken for a moment. It 
might have just been 
my imagination, but in her voice, I caught 
a glimpse of— 
an emotion that seemed to cling to me for 
support.
choice_data_list:
(—Either way, I have to give her an 
answer.)

text_block_list.text:
I quietly met Phalaenopsis's gaze. 
Without realizing it, I was clenching my 
right fist tightly.

Guiding an Umamusume's future is my duty. 
Which meant that right now, when she has 
lost her way— 
I needed to pour everything I had into 
supporting her.
choice_data_list: Would you come with me for a moment?

text_block_list.text:
And so, where we arrived 
was the dojo at the Club.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What do you intend to do here?
choice_data_list: Here, take this!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Kendo, is it?
choice_data_list:
Do you remember? When we sparred back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... With this, I had you purge the 
impurities weighing upon your heart, did I 
not?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, that's the spirit! 
Turn your blade inward, toward your very 
heart!

On the day I met Phalaenopsis, 
she made me confront my own weakness— 
my fear of being entrusted with an 
Umamusume's future.

Because of that, I was able to face my 
fear. 
So this time—
choice_data_list: Come at me!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Our abilities are too far apart. 
I appreciate your concern, but with your 
skill...
choice_data_list: I'll be fine! I can take it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
You're the one who trained me—I'm not that 
fragile.

You trained me yourself, you know. I'm not 
that fragile.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Very well, then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will hold back, of course. But even 
so... 
if you feel any fear, cry out.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Here I come.

*WHAM!* A single stroke. Her shinai came 
crashing down toward me. The moment I 
blocked it, 
an impact that shook me to the core shot 
through my body.
choice_data_list: (Ngh... Her strikes are so heavy...!)
(Ugh... Her strikes are so heavy...!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...
choice_data_list:
I'm fine! Really, I'm fine, so don't hold 
back!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ............Understood.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Haaah!

—*Thud.* A crushing blow echoed deep into 
my body. 
Both of my hands went numb. With every 
strike I deflected, 
my fingertips lost sensation from the 
sheer pain.
choice_data_list: Ngh... ugh...!

text_block_list.text:
Still, I endured. I strove to make 
Phalaenopsis believe 
she could strike without hesitation— 
to earn her absolute trust.
choice_data_list: Come on, give me more!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ............As long as I kept winning.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
One after another, as long as I produced 
results... 
I thought I could repay my debt to the 
Club.

Her onslaught grew fiercer. I tried my 
best to absorb 
the force with my entire body... but each 
blow was 
so heavy that pain flared with every 
impact.
choice_data_list: Guh... More! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I thought that by winning GⅠs, racing 
for the Tiara... 
a 'beautiful garden' would be waiting on 
the other side.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet—this murky sediment of doubt will not 
fade.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I proved my strength in the Tiara, 
but... 
even so... was I really...—

—I had almost completely lost feeling in 
both hands. 
Even so, I held my ground. Her pain, her 
wounds— 
I would shoulder them together with her, 
head-on.
choice_data_list: Ngh... I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.text:
...I wouldn't let her think I was 
unreliable ever again. 
Taking blow after blow without falling, I 
would show her 
I was someone worthy of receiving her 
strikes.

I would become an adult she could truly 
lean on. 
Someone she could confess to when the pain 
became too much.

Otherwise—I had no right to call myself 
Phalaenopsis's Trainer.
choice_data_list: Come on! One more!
Come at me! One more!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If the Club's vanguard— 
had not been Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: If only I... had been Spe...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If I were Sky... or El. 
If I were Brian, or Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If they had been the vanguard... surely 
they 
would have done so much more than someone 
like me...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: A beautiful future for the Club—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—could they not have brought about 
the very future I longed to give 
them...!!?

A devastating strike, like a lightning 
bolt crashing down. 
The moment I took it, I felt as if 
every limb in my body had been shattered 
to pieces.
choice_data_list: Gwaaah...!!
Ghaaargh...!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: !! H-Hey, are you all right?!
choice_data_list: *pant*, *pant*... No...
*pant*, *pant*... No, don't say that...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What...?
choice_data_list: —It has to be you.
—It has to be you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
You're the only one who can bring a future 
to the Club.

You're the only one who can bring the Club 
a future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...How can you say that? How can you 
speak with such absolute certainty...?
choice_data_list:
Because you're the one who received the 
Club's love.

Because you're the one who received the 
Club's love.

text_block_list.text:
For instance, suppose Special Week had 
belonged to the Club 
from the very beginning, and on top of 
that, 
ran as the "Club's vanguard"—

A prosperous future might have awaited 
down that path. 
...Yet that would take an entirely 
different shape 
from the one Phalaenopsis brings.
choice_data_list:
There is definitely a future that only you 
can bring.

There's definitely a future that only you 
can bring.

text_block_list.text:
Because Phalaenopsis had all the Club's 
hopes poured into her— 
and was helped back onto her feet.

And because she stands on the turf through 
the Club's devotion, 
her victories carry the indisputable truth 
that the Club achieved it.
choice_data_list:
In other words, your hoofprints are the 
Club's hoofprints.

In other words, your hoofprints are the 
Club's hoofprints.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: The Club's... hoofprints...

Phalaenopsis is the only one who can truly 
embody the Club's worth. 
That is why—

—By her ushering in that future, 
the Club will become a "beautiful garden" 
beyond compare.
choice_data_list:
So please, don't say things like "if it 
were any other girl."

text_block_list.text:
Neither the members of the Club— 
nor I—would ever want to hear that.

I look straight back into Phalaenopsis's 
eyes once more, 
offering her my heartfelt truth.
choice_data_list:
I know you'll be fine. You can seize that 
future.

I know you'll be fine. You'll seize that 
future.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha... 
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Why...? I was groping in total darkness. 
Yet why, merely by having you... having 
your convictions 
lend me their strength—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Does my heart feel so light?
choice_data_list:
Let's figure out how to face this 
together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
Yes, you are right.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Will you think on it with me, then? As 
one.

Nothing has truly been resolved yet. 
All we have done is clearly define 
the anxieties she carries inside. And yet—
The light in her eyes has not died.
